findings.evidence: HausdorffDimension.lean:57-72 states `∃ w ∈ U, w ∉ f '' s` for open U ⊇ Lipschitz curve; CurveDistance.lean:77 states `∃ w₀ ∈ Ω, ∀ t ∈ uIcc a b, γ t ≠ w₀` for open Ω ⊇ continuous curve. Both feed the homology Cauchy base point; grep for exists_mem_notMem_image_of_isOpen_of_lipschitzOnWith finds no use outside its defining file.
findings.fix: Consolidate to one lemma. The new continuity-only compactness/connectedness proof is strictly more general and simpler than the Lipschitz+Hausdorff-dimension route, so prefer it and retire the now-dead exists_mem_notMem_image_of_isOpen_of_lipschitzOnWith (and reassess whether the ℂ-specific corollary in HausdorffDimension.lean still earns its place); alternatively reuse the existing lemma here by deriving LipschitzOnWith for the pc1 curve. Do not leave two lemmas serving the identical downstream role.
findings.issue: exists_mem_off_curve (open Ω ⊇ curve ⇒ point of Ω off the curve) is a parallel API to the existing TauCeti.exists_mem_notMem_image_of_isOpen_of_lipschitzOnWith (HausdorffDimension.lean:60), which proves the same fact and whose module doc states it is 'the prerequisite that supplies the interior evaluation point off a curve' and 'Prerequisite for the homology Cauchy theorem.' That lemma now has zero consumers (grep: used only inside its own file), while this PR — the homology Cauchy theorem — adds and uses a competing lemma instead.

summary: The new exists_mem_off_curve duplicates the role of the pre-existing exists_mem_notMem_image_of_isOpen_of_lipschitzOnWith, which was built specifically to supply the off-curve base point for the homology Cauchy theorem and is now orphaned. The derivative-integrability lemmas are new plumbing with no direct Mathlib/TauCeti equivalent.
